source_title: Bloomberg Law Connects Dockets and Litigation Intelligence With Claude - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Connector lets legal professionals work with Bloomberg Law court data and litigation insights directly in Claude
ARLINGTON, Va. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bloomberg Law today highlighted its connector for Claude, giving legal professionals access to its collection of federal and state court dockets data and litigation intelligence within Claude. Users can search and retrieve docket details and filing information, monitor matters with alerts and tracks, and surface litigation insights in the AI tool they already use.
The connector uses Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standard that connects AI applications with external data and tools. It enables customers to bring Bloomberg Law dockets and litigation intelligence into their work in Claude, without conducting a separate search on the Bloomberg Law platform.
"The value of an AI tool depends on the quality of the information it draws on," said Aaron Pierce, head of Bloomberg Law. "Connecting Claude with Bloomberg Law's dockets and litigation intelligence gives legal professionals the ability to review and compare filings, understand litigation trends, and identify opportunities within the same workflow."
The Claude integration reflects Bloomberg Law's broader approach of meeting legal professionals where they work, both on the Bloomberg Law platform and in third-party tools. These connections give customers more choice in how they access Bloomberg Law intelligence for awareness and analysis.
For more information, visit https://aboutblaw.com/bm7Y .
Bloomberg Law provides the content and technology legal professionals need to act decisively in a rapidly changing world. Trusted by law firms, corporations, and government agencies, the Bloomberg Law platform combines authoritative news, expert guidance, market intelligence, and advanced research tools to equip legal professionals with the insights they need to deliver guidance with confidence.
Bloomberg Law is part of Bloomberg Industry Group, an affiliate of Bloomberg L.P., a global leader in business and financial information, data, news, and insights.
For more information, visit pro.bloomberglaw.com .
